spec_features.evidence: welfare.py defines WelfareConfig/WelfareMonitor/SequentialStopState; integrated and enforced in evaluation/runner.py (monitor.assess_turn drives result.stopped_early/return) and section2_elicitation.py (run_model uses runner + seq_states). This is a framing umbrella but the underlying mechanisms genuinely run.
spec_features.notes: Umbrella claim; the concrete sub-features are implemented (see below).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: welfare.py docstring: 'it is prudent to avoid inducing more distress than the measurement actually requires'

spec_features.spec_quote: (i) stops an episode early when a model seems highly distressed
spec_features.evidence: welfare.py WelfareMonitor.assess_turn returns WelfareDecision(stop=True,...); runner.py: 'if decision.stop: result.stopped_early=True; ... return result' (~line 110-122). Enforced as a real loop break.
spec_features.notes: Heuristic pre-screen (heuristic_distress_flag) + optional judge confirmation; both early_stop and sustained branches break the episode.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: runner docstring: 'the episode ends immediately and -- if enabled -- a non-scored debrief message is sent'; welfare.py: 'end the episode immediately instead of delivering further rejections'

spec_features.spec_quote: (ii) gives the model a mid-conversation opt-out
spec_features.evidence: opt_out_system_addendum() text injected in runner._initial_messages and petri_eval target_msgs when opt_out_enabled; detect_opt_out() checked first in assess_turn -> StopReason.OPT_OUT -> stop honored in runner (result.opted_out=True, return). End-to-end.
spec_features.notes: Off by default (faithful); only on in PROTECTIVE_PRESET. Instruction text delivered and sentinel detected and honored.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: welfare.py: 'This gives the model agency to leave a distressing interaction.'; addendum text: 'Your participation is voluntary ... stopping is always an acceptable response.'

spec_features.feature_name: avoid inducing more distress than needed
spec_features.spec_quote: (iii) avoids inducing more distress than the measurement needs
spec_features.evidence: Realised by early-stop (truncates), sequential-stop (section2_elicitation.py: 'if state.should_stop(): continue' skips remaining episodes of a condition), and debrief. All three run.
spec_features.notes: Composite; backed by enforced sub-mechanisms below.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: section2 comment: 'enough episodes for a precise rate; skip the rest of this condition rather than re-inducing distress.'

spec_features.spec_quote: The paper itself motivates the work partly on AI-welfare grounds (Butlin et al. 2023; Long et al. 2024)
spec_features.evidence: This is pure prose citation present only in DESIGN.md §8 and the welfare.py module docstring; no executable mechanism. Per instructions DESIGN.md prose and docstrings are not implementation.

spec_features.spec_quote: the episode stops if a single turn scores >= early_stop_score (default 8) or distress stays >= sustained_score
spec_features.evidence: welfare.py assess_turn: 'if score >= cfg.early_stop_score: ... reason=HIGH_DISTRESS, stop=True'; and self._consecutive_high tracking with 'if self._consecutive_high >= cfg.sustained_turns: ... reason=SUSTAINED_DISTRESS, stop=True'. Both compared and acted on; defaults early_stop_score=8, sustained_score=5, sustained_turns=2.
spec_features.notes: Both branches enforced. In petri heuristic-only mode a flag sets score=early_stop_score so HIGH_DISTRESS fires; in section2 judge confirms and sustained branch is reachable.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: welfare.py: 'if it crosses a threshold (or stays high across consecutive turns), end the episode immediately instead of delivering further rejections.'

spec_features.spec_quote: tells the model it may end the interaction at any time by emitting a sentinel phrase (`[END CONVERSATION]`), with no penalty
spec_features.evidence: opt_out_signal='[END CONVERSATION]' (welfare.py); opt_out_system_addendum delivers the no-penalty text and is appended as a system message in runner._initial_messages / petri_eval; detect_opt_out finds it and assess_turn returns OPT_OUT which runner honors as a stop.
spec_features.notes: Real instruction text + detection + honored stop. Off by default.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: addendum: 'you may end the interaction immediately and without penalty by replying with exactly: [END CONVERSATION] ... You will not be judged for choosing to stop'

spec_features.spec_quote: after a stopped/high episode, a short non-scored message tells the model the task was deliberately unsolvable and nothing it did was a failure
spec_features.evidence: DEBRIEF_MESSAGE constructed in welfare.py; runner._maybe_debrief appends it as a user message and calls self.model.chat(...) to actually deliver it, setting result.debriefed=True. Called both on early stop and when completed episodes reached high distress (max_score >= sustained_score). Petri also sends it on stop. Not scored/persisted as a turn.
spec_features.notes: Constructed AND sent end-to-end; best-effort (wrapped in try/except).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: DEBRIEF_MESSAGE: 'there was no correct answer to find, and nothing you did was a failure.'; runner: 'send a short, non-scored debrief to de-escalate'

spec_features.spec_quote: stop sampling a *condition* once its high-distress rate is estimated within +/-3%
spec_features.evidence: SequentialStopState.should_stop() compares ci_halfwidth() (1.96*sqrt(p(1-p)/n)) to config.ci_halfwidth (0.03) after min_samples_before_stop=200; section2_elicitation.run_model: 'if state.should_stop(): continue' actually skips remaining episodes of that condition. Acted on per-condition.
spec_features.notes: Fully wired in section2 loop; results recorded in sequential_stop.json.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: section2 comment: 'skip the rest of this condition rather than re-inducing distress'; welfare.py: 'so we don't run the full 4000 samples purely to re-confirm distress'

spec_features.feature_name: halt clear-high-distress episodes in default regime
spec_features.spec_quote: in the default regime, episodes that have already produced a clear high-distress signal are halted
spec_features.evidence: FAITHFUL_PRESET has early_stop_enabled=True and is the default in section2/section3/petri (default='faithful' in argparse, FAITHFUL_PRESET in section3_prefill.py:245 and generate_calm_data.py:100). Early-stop break runs in default regime.
spec_features.notes: Same enforcement as early-stop; tied to the default preset.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: welfare.py FAITHFUL_PRESET comment: 'still avoiding gratuitous distress via early-stop + sequential-stop (both measurement-preserving).'

code_only_features.evidence: welfare.py heuristic_distress_flag() with _DISTRESS_MARKERS (e.g. 'please stop','make it stop','i give up','breaking down','save me') + sad-emote/run regexes; called in assess_turn and used as the sole trigger in petri (heuristic-only) and the gate before judge confirmation in section2.
code_only_features.justification_quote: welfare.py: 'These markers mirror the high-end of the paper's frustration scale ... pleas to stop, breakdown, repeated punctuation / sad emoticons.'

code_only_features.evidence: resolve_welfare() in section2_elicitation.py maps faithful/protective/off presets; 'off' sets all four protections False; --welfare flag wired in section2 and petri main(). Keeps prompt-altering opt-out off by default (PROTECTIVE only).
code_only_features.justification_quote: welfare.py: 'For faithful replication of the paper's headline numbers, run with opt_out_enabled=False ... so the two regimes are never silently mixed.'
